notes: V10.0.17 is rebuilt from the verified V10.0.15 stable base. V10 Custom Map adds optional SAFE ENTRY for MiuMiu selling: move to SAFE ENTRY, UP+Jump, then verify SAFE before selling. After a successful MiuMiu sale, RETURN TO FARM aligns to SAFE_ENTRY_X on the upper SAFE floor, uses DOWN+Jump, confirms farm-lane Y, then resumes normal farming. The separate wrong-floor FARM RETURN feature is not included. Built-in maps and maps.json remain unchanged.
